hex_map.note: 7-hex map: 1 center + 6 surrounding. Each hex produces a resource when its number is rolled on 2d6.

settlement_map.note: 18 vertices of the 7-hex grid in 3 rings (inner v0-v5, middle v6-v11, outer v12-v17). Edges represent road connections between adjacent vertices. Each node's adjacent_hexes encodes which hex resources it touches.

hand.note: Player's resource cards, hidden from opponent.

victory_points.note: Victory point total. 1 per settlement. First to 5 wins.

resource_card.note: Resource cards produced by hex tiles and held in player hands.

settlement.note: Placed on vertices of the hex grid. Each scores 1 VP.

road.note: Placed on edges between vertices. Built with 1 wood + 1 brick.

phases.name: roll_dice
phases.note: Server rolls 2d6, sums the result. All hexes with matching number produce resources for players with adjacent settlements.

phases.name: collect_resources
phases.note: For each hex matching the roll, each adjacent settlement earns its owner 1 resource card of that hex's type.

phases.name: trade_or_build
phases.action: trade OR build_road OR build_settlement OR pass
phases.note: Active player may trade 4 identical resources for 1 of any type, build a road (1 wood + 1 brick), build a settlement (1 wood + 1 brick + 1 sheep + 1 wheat), or pass to end turn.

dice_production.effect: each hex with number == roll produces 1 resource for each adjacent settlement owner
dice_production.definition: When 2d6 are rolled, hexes whose number token matches the sum produce resources. Each settlement adjacent to a producing hex earns its owner 1 card of that resource type.

requires: player has settlement or road at vertex_a or vertex_b
build_road.effect: spend 1 wood + 1 brick; place road on edge
build_road.definition: Build a road on an unoccupied edge adjacent to your existing network.

requires: hand contains 1 wood AND 1 brick AND 1 sheep AND 1 wheat
no adjacent vertex has a settlement (distance rule)
player has road to vertex (except during setup)
build_settlement.effect: spend 1 wood + 1 brick + 1 sheep + 1 wheat; place settlement; gain 1 VP
build_settlement.definition: Build a settlement on an unoccupied vertex. Must be at least 2 edges from any other settlement.

bank_trade.effect: discard 4 of resource_give, gain 1 of resource_want
bank_trade.definition: Trade 4 identical resource cards to the bank for 1 card of any type.

distance_rule.definition: Settlements must be at least 2 edges apart. No vertex adjacent to an existing settlement may hold a new settlement.
